goal: Implement R-003 YAML graph topology loader so graph.yaml can be loaded at startup without recompiling.
requirements: Define schema for nodes, edges, partitions, and watermarks.
Validate node types against the registered node catalog.
Return actionable errors for unknown node types.
Compare loaded CompiledPlan to a hand-built plan for byte equivalence.
constraints: Startup-only loader; no YAML parsing on hot paths.
No hot reload or mutation via YAML edit.
No YAML schema versioning in this slice.
acceptance_criteria: Load test covers a 5-node graph from YAML.
Loaded CompiledPlan is byte-equivalent to hand-built plan.
